name: hs_code
description: 8-digit Harmonized System / AHTN tariff classification code

name: destination_country
description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 destination country code (e.g. SG, IN)

name: required_documents
description: List of mandatory regulatory certificates or permits

name: rule_set
description: Rule set the row belongs to, e.g. 'demo-curated' (prototype rules, not an official source)

name: regulation_ref
description: Reference shown with requirements derived from this row; prototype wording for the demo rule set

name: description_embedding
description: Text embedding of the description, generated with the remote embedding model (ML.GENERATE_EMBEDDING). The dimension is whatever that model returns; stored and query vectors must come from the same model.
